query: Run /init for a headless CLI project. It has no screens, browser UI, or user-visible design source. Set up the project memory, tell me whether we need a design contract, and when this should be reconsidered.
expected_behavior: Initializes the requested project memory using the existing canonical templates
Does not invent a screen contract, palette, UI patterns, or browser verification for the headless project
States that design-contract discovery can be revisited if user-visible interface behavior is introduced
